label: n13a
cmd: for i in $(seq 1 200); do n=$(gh run view 42207582470 -R JupiterianSoul/botlatro-sim --json jobs -q '[.jobs[]|select(.status=="completed" and (.name|startswith("dat-")))]|length'); [ "$n" -ge 20 ] 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 60; done; [ "$n" -ge 20 ] || exit 1; echo data jobs done $n; gh run download 42207582470 -R JupiterianSoul/botlatro-sim -p 'bench-dat-*' -D gen13; gh run download 41234932764 -R JupiterianSoul/botlatro-sim -n r5val-net -D ft; PYTHONPATH=tools/botsim/train python3 tools/botsim/train/trim.py $(find gen13 -name 'x*.bspr'); PYTHONPATH=tools/botsim/train python3 tools/botsim/train/relabel.py gen13; ls gen13 | head -3; find gen13 -name 'x*.bspr' -size +0c | wc -l; python3 tools/botsim/train/train.py --data $(find gen13 -name 'x*.bspr' -size +0c) --init ft/net.bnnw --policy-min-sims 1 --window 0 --steps 20000 --value-ante 1 --value-weight 1 --value-win 0 --anchor 1 --out $OUT/net.bnnw > $OUT/train.txt 2>&1; tail -3 $OUT/train.txt; PYTHONPATH=tools/botsim/train python3 tools/botsim/train/test/unjudged_mass.py $OUT/net.bnnw $(find gen13 -name 'x*.bspr' -size +0c | sort | head -6) >> $OUT/mass.txt 2>&1; tail -1 $OUT/mass.txt; test -s $OUT/net.bnnw
